body_paragraphs: On 20 September 2026 I received an Example 4-slice toaster I bought from you online for £64.99 (order ORD-48213). Since 25 October it has stopped working properly: the lever won’t stay down and one slot doesn’t heat. It has only been used normally in my kitchen.
I contacted you through your online chat on 27 October and was told to contact the manufacturer. My contract is with you as the retailer, not with the manufacturer.

Under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, goods must be of satisfactory quality and fit for purpose. As the fault appeared within 6 months of delivery, it is presumed to have been there when the toaster was delivered, unless you can show otherwise. You have one opportunity to repair or replace faulty goods.
I am asking you to replace the toaster, at no cost to me, within a reasonable time. Please also tell me how you would like me to return the faulty one.
evidence_to_keep: Keep your order confirmation for ORD-48213 and the delivery email.
Keep a copy or screenshot of the online chat from 27 October.
Keep a short video showing the lever not staying down and the cold slot.
Keep the toaster and its packaging until this is resolved.
